task.pr_title: Support MINID and LIMIT on XADD

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.
cases.description:
Maxlen and minid are mutually exclusive. This would allow us to specify both in the command.
https://redis.io/commands/XADD

evidence.attached_diff_hunk:
@@ -1649,6 +1649,8 @@ def xadd(self, name, fields, id='*', maxlen=None, approximate=True,
         maxlen: truncate old stream members beyond this size
         approximate: actual stream length may be slightly more than maxlen
         nomkstream: When set to true, do not make a stream
+        minid: the minimum id in the stream to query
+        limit: specifies the maximum number of entries to retrieve
         """
         pieces = []
         if maxlen is not None:
